test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Only P sits to the left of Q. Only three people sit between T and R. Only three people sit between Q and R. S sits to the immediate right of R. P sits at one of the extreme ends of the row. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Only P sits to the left of Q. P sits at one of the extreme ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feb6d35bdd7555cd90cea94395537d486ebab3fe057c6c8255ea7619b8d3854a.png] 

Step 2: Only three people sit between Q and R. Only three people sit between T and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/295615919cf7ee78fcd2589947db2a4634fc1e6d3603b2f12cd69d3acb24e3b7.png] 

Step 3: S sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c7c3fe933eec9148d520d8f55d4abb45a47ecf3a89faf22c30a0d1533831239.png] 

From the arrangement we can see that **there are total 10 people.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
